```{r}
# Create clean clinical metadata file for MOFA2 downstream analysis
CLINICAL_FILE <- file.path(
  OUT_DIR,
  "ClinicalCorrelation.csv"
)

CLINICAL_CLEAN_FILE <- file.path(
  OUT_DIR,
  "ClinicalCorrelation_clean_for_MOFA2.csv"
)

clean_sample_id <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- basename(x)
  x <- trimws(x)
  x <- toupper(x)

  x <- gsub("\\.", "-", x)

  x <- sub("_T$", "", x)
  x <- sub("-T$", "", x)
  x <- sub("T$", "", x)

  x <- sub("_N$", "", x)
  x <- sub("-N$", "", x)
  x <- sub("NL$", "", x)

  x <- sub("^(TP[0-9]+)-0+([0-9]+)$", "\\1-\\2", x)

  x
}

clean_text <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  x[x %in% c("", "NA", "Na", "na", "N/A", "n/a")] <- NA_character_
  x
}

parse_numeric_clinical <- function(x) {
  x <- clean_text(x)

  # Identify values beginning with "<"
  is_less_than <- !is.na(x) & grepl("^<\\s*[0-9.]+$", x)

  # Remove "<" and convert to numeric
  numeric_values <- suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(gsub("^<\\s*", "", x))
  )

  # Replace values reported as "<N" with N/2
  numeric_values[is_less_than] <-
    numeric_values[is_less_than] / 2

  numeric_values
}

standardize_pos_neg <- function(x) {
  x <- toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))

  out <- rep(NA_character_, length(x))
  out[grepl("^POS", x)] <- "Positive"
  out[grepl("^NEG", x)] <- "Negative"

  out
}

make_hr_status <- function(er, pr) {
  out <- rep(NA_character_, length(er))

  out[er == "Positive" | pr == "Positive"] <- "HR+"
  out[er == "Negative" & pr == "Negative"] <- "HR-"

  out
}

make_hr_her2_subtype <- function(hr, her2) {
  out <- rep(NA_character_, length(hr))

  out[hr == "HR+" & her2 == "Negative"] <- "HR+/HER2-"
  out[hr == "HR+" & her2 == "Positive"] <- "HR+/HER2+"
  out[hr == "HR-" & her2 == "Negative"] <- "Triple-negative"
  out[hr == "HR-" & her2 == "Positive"] <- "HR-/HER2+"

  out
}

pick_col <- function(dt, patterns, label) {
  hits <- unique(unlist(lapply(patterns, function(p) {
    grep(p, colnames(dt), value = TRUE)
  })))

  if (length(hits) == 0) {
    stop("Could not find column for: ", label)
  }

  hits[1]
}

# ----------------------------
# Load raw clinical file
# ----------------------------

clinical_raw <- fread(CLINICAL_FILE)

# Clean column names for easier matching
old_names <- colnames(clinical_raw)
new_names <- make.names(trimws(old_names), unique = TRUE)
setnames(clinical_raw, old_names, new_names)

colnames(clinical_raw)

# ----------------------------
# Identify required columns
# ----------------------------

sample_col <- pick_col(
  clinical_raw,
  patterns = c("^Sample.name$"),
  label = "Sample name"
)

age_col <- pick_col(
  clinical_raw,
  patterns = c("^Age.at.Diagnosis$"),
  label = "Age at Diagnosis"
)

tumor_cell_col <- pick_col(
  clinical_raw,
  patterns = c("MirrorFFPE_overall_tumor_cellularity"),
  label = "overall tumor cellularity"
)

pleo_cell_col <- pick_col(
  clinical_raw,
  patterns = c("MirrorFFPE_pleomorphic_invasive"),
  label = "pleomorphic invasive component cellularity"
)

til_col <- pick_col(
  clinical_raw,
  patterns = c("MirrorFFPE_TILs"),
  label = "TILs"
)

grade_col <- pick_col(
  clinical_raw,
  patterns = c("Grade.Differentiation"),
  label = "Grade"
)

her2_col <- pick_col(
  clinical_raw,
  patterns = c("Her.2.Neu"),
  label = "HER2"
)

er_col <- pick_col(
  clinical_raw,
  patterns = c("Tumor.Marker.*ER"),
  label = "ER"
)

pr_col <- pick_col(
  clinical_raw,
  patterns = c("Tumor.Marker.*PR"),
  label = "PR"
)

# ----------------------------
# Generate clean clinical table
# ----------------------------

clinical_clean <- clinical_raw[
  ,
  .(
    Sample = clean_sample_id(get(sample_col)),
    Age_at_Diagnosis = parse_numeric_clinical(get(age_col)),
    Tumor_cellularity = parse_numeric_clinical(get(tumor_cell_col)),
    Pleomorphic_invasive_component_cellularity = parse_numeric_clinical(get(pleo_cell_col)),
    TILs = parse_numeric_clinical(get(til_col)),
    Grade = clean_text(get(grade_col)),
    HER2_status = standardize_pos_neg(get(her2_col)),
    ER_status = standardize_pos_neg(get(er_col)),
    PR_status = standardize_pos_neg(get(pr_col))
  )
]

clinical_clean[
  ,
  HR_status := make_hr_status(ER_status, PR_status)
]

clinical_clean[
  ,
  HR_HER2_subtype := make_hr_her2_subtype(HR_status, HER2_status)
]

# Remove duplicate sample rows if present
clinical_clean <- unique(clinical_clean, by = "Sample")

# Order by sample
setorder(clinical_clean, Sample)

clinical_clean

# ----------------------------
# Save clean file
# ----------------------------

fwrite(
  clinical_clean,
  CLINICAL_CLEAN_FILE
)

CLINICAL_CLEAN_FILE
```
```{r }
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Add sample metadata to trained MOFA2 model
# ------------------------------------------------------------

CLINICAL_CLEAN_FILE <- file.path(
  OUT_DIR,
  "ClinicalCorrelation_clean_for_MOFA2.csv"
)

sample_view_file <- file.path(
  TABLE_DIR,
  "MOFA2_training_sample_view_presence.tsv"
)

if (!file.exists(CLINICAL_CLEAN_FILE)) {
  stop("Clean clinical metadata file not found: ", CLINICAL_CLEAN_FILE)
}

if (!file.exists(sample_view_file)) {
  stop("Sample-view metadata file not found: ", sample_view_file)
}
```

```{r metadata-helper-functions}
clean_sample_id <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- basename(x)
  x <- trimws(x)
  x <- toupper(x)

  # Standardize RNA-style sample IDs
  # TP03.117  -> TP03-117
  # TP15.M509 -> TP15-M509
  x <- gsub("\\.", "-", x)

  # Remove tumor/normal suffixes
  x <- sub("_T$", "", x)
  x <- sub("-T$", "", x)
  x <- sub("T$", "", x)

  x <- sub("_N$", "", x)
  x <- sub("-N$", "", x)
  x <- sub("NL$", "", x)

  # Normalize IDs such as TP09-09 -> TP09-9
  x <- sub("^(TP[0-9]+)-0+([0-9]+)$", "\\1-\\2", x)

  x
}
```

```{r load-metadata-files}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Load model samples
# ------------------------------------------------------------

model_samples <- data.table(
  sample = clean_sample_id(samples_names(model)[[1]])
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Load sample-view availability metadata
# ------------------------------------------------------------

sample_view_metadata <- fread(sample_view_file)

sample_view_metadata[
  ,
  sample := clean_sample_id(sample)
]

sample_view_metadata[
  ,
  view_completeness := fifelse(
    n_views_present == 4, "4 views",
    fifelse(
      n_views_present == 3, "3 views",
      fifelse(
        n_views_present == 2, "2 views",
        fifelse(n_views_present == 1, "1 view", "Unknown")
      )
    )
  )
]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Load clean clinical metadata
# ------------------------------------------------------------

clinical_metadata <- fread(CLINICAL_CLEAN_FILE)

clinical_metadata[
  ,
  sample := clean_sample_id(Sample)
]

clinical_metadata <- unique(clinical_metadata, by = "sample")
```

```{r merge-metadata}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Merge model samples with view metadata and clinical metadata
# ------------------------------------------------------------

sample_metadata <- merge(
  model_samples,
  sample_view_metadata,
  by = "sample",
  all.x = TRUE
)

sample_metadata <- merge(
  sample_metadata,
  clinical_metadata,
  by = "sample",
  all.x = TRUE
)

# Keep same sample order as model
sample_metadata <- sample_metadata[
  match(model_samples$sample, sample)
]

# Check for duplicated samples
if (anyDuplicated(sample_metadata$sample) > 0) {
  duplicated_samples <- sample_metadata[
    duplicated(sample) | duplicated(sample, fromLast = TRUE),
    sample
  ]

  stop(
    "Duplicated samples found in metadata after merging: ",
    paste(unique(duplicated_samples), collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# Check for model samples missing clinical metadata
missing_clinical <- sample_metadata[
  is.na(Age_at_Diagnosis) &
    is.na(Grade) &
    is.na(HR_HER2_subtype),
  sample
]

if (length(missing_clinical) > 0) {
  message(
    "Model samples without clinical metadata: ",
    paste(missing_clinical, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

sample_metadata
```

# 6. Variance decomposition

Variance decomposition identifies how much variance each MOFA2 factor explains in each molecular view. This helps determine which factors are biologically informative and which omics layers contribute most strongly to each factor.

```{r variance-decomposition}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Calculate variance explained
# ------------------------------------------------------------

variance_explained <- get_variance_explained(model)

names(variance_explained)

variance_explained$r2_total
variance_explained$r2_per_factor
```

```{r save-total-variance-explained}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Save total variance explained per view
# ------------------------------------------------------------

r2_total <- variance_explained$r2_total[[1]]

# Convert 2D array/matrix safely to data.table
r2_total_dt <- as.data.table(as.data.frame(r2_total), keep.rownames = "view")

# Rename value column
if (ncol(r2_total_dt) == 2) {
  setnames(r2_total_dt, old = names(r2_total_dt)[2], new = "R2_total")
}

r2_total_dt

fwrite(
  r2_total_dt,
  file.path(DOWNSTREAM_DIR, "MOFA2_total_variance_explained_by_view.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)
```

```{r save-variance-explained-per-factor}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Save variance explained by each factor in each view
# ------------------------------------------------------------

r2_per_factor <- variance_explained$r2_per_factor[[1]]

r2_per_factor_dt <- as.data.table(
  r2_per_factor,
  keep.rownames = "factor"
)

r2_per_factor_dt

fwrite(
  r2_per_factor_dt,
  file.path(DOWNSTREAM_DIR, "MOFA2_variance_explained_per_factor_per_view.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)
```

```{r reshape-variance-long}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Convert variance explained table to long format
# ------------------------------------------------------------

r2_per_factor_long <- melt(
  r2_per_factor_dt,
  id.vars = "factor",
  variable.name = "view",
  value.name = "R2"
)

r2_per_factor_long[
  ,
  factor := as.character(factor)
]

r2_per_factor_long[
  ,
  R2 := as.numeric(R2)
]

r2_per_factor_long <- r2_per_factor_long[
  order(factor, -R2)
]

r2_per_factor_long

fwrite(
  r2_per_factor_long,
  file.path(DOWNSTREAM_DIR, "MOFA2_variance_explained_per_factor_per_view_long.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)
```

```{r summarize-dominant-view-per-factor}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Identify dominant molecular view for each factor
# ------------------------------------------------------------

dominant_view_per_factor <- r2_per_factor_long[
  ,
  .SD[which.max(R2)],
  by = factor
]

setnames(
  dominant_view_per_factor,
  old = c("view", "R2"),
  new = c("dominant_view", "dominant_view_R2")
)

dominant_view_per_factor <- dominant_view_per_factor[
  order(factor)
]

dominant_view_per_factor

fwrite(
  dominant_view_per_factor,
  file.path(DOWNSTREAM_DIR, "MOFA2_dominant_view_per_factor.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)
```

```{r summarize-active-factors}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Summarize total variance explained across views for each factor
# ------------------------------------------------------------

factor_r2_summary <- r2_per_factor_long[
  ,
  .(
    mean_R2_across_views = mean(R2, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_R2_across_views = max(R2, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum_R2_across_views = sum(R2, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_views_with_R2_gt_1pct = sum(R2 > 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_views_with_R2_gt_5pct = sum(R2 > 5, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  by = factor
]

factor_r2_summary <- factor_r2_summary[
  order(-sum_R2_across_views)
]

factor_r2_summary

fwrite(
  factor_r2_summary,
  file.path(DOWNSTREAM_DIR, "MOFA2_factor_variance_summary.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)
```

```{r plot-custom-variance-heatmap}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Custom ggplot heatmap for variance explained
# ------------------------------------------------------------

p_var_heatmap <- ggplot(
  r2_per_factor_long,
  aes(x = view, y = factor, fill = R2)
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = round(R2, 1)),
    size = 3
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "MOFA2 variance explained by factor and molecular view",
    x = "Molecular view",
    y = "MOFA2 factor",
    fill = "Variance explained (%)"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )

p_var_heatmap

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(DOWNSTREAM_DIR, "04_MOFA2_variance_explained_heatmap_custom.pdf"),
  plot = p_var_heatmap,
  width = 9,
  height = 5
)
```

# 7. Visualisation of factors

MOFA2 factors represent major axes of multi-omic variation across samples. In this section, factor scores are exported and visualized using sample metadata, including view completeness and clinical annotations.

```{r export-factor-scores}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Extract and save MOFA2 factor scores
# ------------------------------------------------------------

factor_scores_dt <- as.data.table(
  get_factors(
    model,
    factors = "all",
    as.data.frame = TRUE
  )
)

factor_scores_dt

factor_scores_wide <- dcast(
  factor_scores_dt,
  sample + group ~ factor,
  value.var = "value"
)

factor_scores_wide

fwrite(
  factor_scores_wide,
  file.path(DOWNSTREAM_DIR, "MOFA2_factor_scores_wide.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)
```

```{r factor-visualisation-settings}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Define factors and metadata variables for visualization
# ------------------------------------------------------------

n_factors <- get_dimensions(model)$K

factors_to_plot <- seq_len(n_factors)

metadata_available <- colnames(samples_metadata(model))

metadata_available

categorical_metadata <- c(
  "view_completeness",
  "HR_HER2_subtype",
  "Grade",
  "HER2_status",
  "ER_status",
  "PR_status",
  "HR_status"
)

categorical_metadata <- categorical_metadata[
  categorical_metadata %in% metadata_available
]

continuous_metadata <- c(
  "Age_at_Diagnosis",
  "Tumor_cellularity",
  "Pleomorphic_invasive_component_cellularity",
  "TILs"
)

continuous_metadata <- continuous_metadata[
  continuous_metadata %in% metadata_available
]

categorical_metadata
continuous_metadata
```

## Visualize individual factors by sample-view completeness

```{r plot-factors-by-view-completeness, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}

  p_factor_view_completeness <- plot_factor(
    model,
    factors = factors_to_plot,
    color_by = "view_completeness",

    dodge = TRUE,
    add_violin = TRUE,
    violin_alpha = 0.25

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      DOWNSTREAM_DIR,
      "05_MOFA2_factor_scores_by_view_completeness.pdf"

}
```

# 8. Visualisation of feature weights

Feature weights indicate which genes or genomic features contribute most strongly to each MOFA2 factor. Features with large absolute weights are the most strongly associated with a factor. Positive and negative weights represent opposite directions along the same factor axis.

Because variance decomposition showed that Factors 1–4 are the main informative factors, this section focuses on Factors 1–4 while still exporting weights for all factors.

```{r weight-visualisation-settings}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Define views and factors for weight visualization
# ------------------------------------------------------------

all_views <- views_names(model)
n_factors <- get_dimensions(model)$K

all_factors <- seq_len(n_factors)

# Based on variance decomposition, focus interpretation on Factors 1-4
FOCUS_FACTORS <- seq_len(min(4, n_factors))

TOP_N_WEIGHTS <- 25

all_views
all_factors
FOCUS_FACTORS
```

```{r extract-feature-weights}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Extract feature weights from MOFA2 model
# ------------------------------------------------------------

weights_dt <- as.data.table(
  get_weights(
    model,
    views = "all",
    factors = "all",
    as.data.frame = TRUE
  )
)

weights_dt[
  ,
  abs_weight := abs(value)
]

weights_dt <- weights_dt[
  order(view, factor, -abs_weight)
]

weights_dt

fwrite(
  weights_dt,
  file.path(DOWNSTREAM_DIR, "MOFA2_feature_weights_long.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)
```
```{r top-weighted-features-by-view-factor}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Top features by absolute weight for each view and factor
# ------------------------------------------------------------

top_weights_dt <- weights_dt[
  ,
  .SD[seq_len(min(.N, TOP_N_WEIGHTS))],
  by = .(view, factor)
]

top_weights_dt

fwrite(
  top_weights_dt,
  file.path(DOWNSTREAM_DIR, "MOFA2_top25_weighted_features_by_view_factor.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)
```
```{r top-positive-negative-weights}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Save top positive and top negative weights separately
# ------------------------------------------------------------

top_positive_weights_dt <- weights_dt[
  value > 0,
  .SD[order(-value)][seq_len(min(.N, TOP_N_WEIGHTS))],
  by = .(view, factor)
]

top_negative_weights_dt <- weights_dt[
  value < 0,
  .SD[order(value)][seq_len(min(.N, TOP_N_WEIGHTS))],
  by = .(view, factor)
]

top_positive_weights_dt[
  ,
  direction := "Positive"
]

top_negative_weights_dt[
  ,
  direction := "Negative"
]

top_directional_weights_dt <- rbindlist(
  list(top_positive_weights_dt, top_negative_weights_dt),
  use.names = TRUE,
  fill = TRUE
)

top_directional_weights_dt <- top_directional_weights_dt[
  order(view, factor, direction, -abs_weight)
]

top_directional_weights_dt

fwrite(
  top_directional_weights_dt,
  file.path(DOWNSTREAM_DIR, "MOFA2_top25_positive_negative_weights_by_view_factor.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)
```

# 9. Visualisation of covariation patterns

This section visualizes how top-weighted features vary across samples in the original input data. Because variance decomposition showed that the strongest signal is mainly from RNA expression with additional WES CNV contribution, we focus primarily on `RNA_VST_top5000var` and `WES_CNV_numeric` for Factors 1–4.

```{r plot-data-heatmaps-rna-cnv}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Heatmaps of top-weighted features for RNA and CNV views
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Top features are selected by their weights in the selected factor.
# Samples are ordered by their factor values unless cluster_cols = TRUE.
all_views <- views_names(model)
n_factors <- get_dimensions(model)$K

# Focus on major informative factors
FOCUS_FACTORS <- seq_len(min(4, n_factors))

# Focus on RNA and CNV views based on variance decomposition
COVARIATION_VIEWS <- c(
  "RNA_VST_top5000var",
  "WES_CNV_numeric"
)

# Keep only views that actually exist in the trained model
COVARIATION_VIEWS <- COVARIATION_VIEWS[
  COVARIATION_VIEWS %in% all_views
]

COVARIATION_VIEWS
for (vv in COVARIATION_VIEWS) {
  for (ff in FOCUS_FACTORS) {
    
    output_file <- file.path(
      DOWNSTREAM_DIR,
      paste0(
        "14_MOFA2_data_heatmap_",
        gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", vv),
        "_Factor",
        ff,
        ".pdf"
      )
    )
    
    message("Generating heatmap: view = ", vv, ", factor = ", ff)
    
    p <- tryCatch(
      {
        plot_data_heatmap(
          model,
          view = vv,
          factor = ff,
          features = 20,
          cluster_rows = TRUE,
          cluster_cols = FALSE,
          show_rownames = TRUE,
          show_colnames = TRUE
        )
      },
      error = function(e) {
        message(
          "Skipping heatmap for view = ", vv,
          ", factor = ", ff,
          ". Error: ", e$message
        )
        NULL
      }
    )
    
    if (!is.null(p)) {
      print(p)
      
      pdf(
        output_file,
        width = 8,
        height = 8
      )
      print(p)
      dev.off()
    }
  }
}
```

# Association between MOFA2 factors and clinical features

This section tests associations between MOFA2 factor scores and clinical features, then generates a heatmap of p-values.

```{r factor-clinical-association-setup}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(ggplot2)
})

# Use factor scores already merged with metadata 
factor_metadata_file <- file.path(
  DOWNSTREAM_DIR,
  "MOFA2_factor_scores_wide_with_metadata.tsv"
)

if (file.exists(factor_metadata_file)) {
  factor_meta_dt <- fread(factor_metadata_file)
} else {
  factor_scores_dt <- as.data.table(
    get_factors(
      model,
      factors = "all",
      as.data.frame = TRUE
    )
  )
  
  factor_scores_wide <- dcast(
    factor_scores_dt,
    sample + group ~ factor,
    value.var = "value"
  )
  
  metadata_dt <- as.data.table(samples_metadata(model))
  
  factor_meta_dt <- merge(
    factor_scores_wide,
    metadata_dt,
    by = c("sample", "group"),
    all.x = TRUE
  )
}

factor_cols <- grep("^Factor", colnames(factor_meta_dt), value = TRUE)

clinical_continuous <- c(
  "Age_at_Diagnosis",
  "Tumor_cellularity",
  "Pleomorphic_invasive_component_cellularity",
  "TILs"
)

clinical_categorical <- c(
  "Grade",
  "HER2_status",
  "ER_status",
  "PR_status",
  "HR_status",
  "HR_HER2_subtype"
)

clinical_continuous <- clinical_continuous[
  clinical_continuous %in% colnames(factor_meta_dt)
]

clinical_categorical <- clinical_categorical[
  clinical_categorical %in% colnames(factor_meta_dt)
]

clinical_features <- c(clinical_continuous, clinical_categorical)

factor_cols
clinical_features
```

```{r factor-clinical-association-tests}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper function for one factor-clinical association test
# ------------------------------------------------------------

test_factor_clinical <- function(dt, factor_col, clinical_col, variable_type) {
  
  tmp <- dt[
    ,
    .(
      factor_value = as.numeric(get(factor_col)),
      clinical_value = get(clinical_col)
    )
  ]
  
  tmp <- tmp[
    !is.na(factor_value) &
      !is.na(clinical_value)
  ]
  
  if (nrow(tmp) < 4) {
    return(data.table(
      factor = factor_col,
      clinical_feature = clinical_col,
      variable_type = variable_type,
      test_used = NA_character_,
      n_samples = nrow(tmp),
      n_groups = NA_integer_,
      estimate = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_
    ))
  }
  
  if (variable_type == "continuous") {
    
    tmp[
      ,
      clinical_value := suppressWarnings(as.numeric(clinical_value))
    ]
    
    tmp <- tmp[
      !is.na(clinical_value)
    ]
    
    if (
      nrow(tmp) < 4 ||
      length(unique(tmp$clinical_value)) < 3 ||
      length(unique(tmp$factor_value)) < 3
    ) {
      return(data.table(
        factor = factor_col,
        clinical_feature = clinical_col,
        variable_type = variable_type,
        test_used = "Spearman correlation",
        n_samples = nrow(tmp),
        n_groups = NA_integer_,
        estimate = NA_real_,
        p_value = NA_real_
      ))
    }
    
    ct <- suppressWarnings(
      cor.test(
        tmp$factor_value,
        tmp$clinical_value,
        method = "spearman",
        exact = FALSE
      )
    )
    
    return(data.table(
      factor = factor_col,
      clinical_feature = clinical_col,
      variable_type = variable_type,
      test_used = "Spearman correlation",
      n_samples = nrow(tmp),
      n_groups = NA_integer_,
      estimate = unname(ct$estimate),
      p_value = ct$p.value
    ))
  }
  
  if (variable_type == "categorical") {
    
    tmp[
      ,
      clinical_value := as.factor(as.character(clinical_value))
    ]
    
    tmp <- tmp[
      !is.na(clinical_value)
    ]
    
    n_groups <- length(unique(tmp$clinical_value))
    
    if (nrow(tmp) < 4 || n_groups < 2) {
      return(data.table(
        factor = factor_col,
        clinical_feature = clinical_col,
        variable_type = variable_type,
        test_used = NA_character_,
        n_samples = nrow(tmp),
        n_groups = n_groups,
        estimate = NA_real_,
        p_value = NA_real_
      ))
    }
    
    if (n_groups == 2) {
      
      wt <- suppressWarnings(
        wilcox.test(
          factor_value ~ clinical_value,
          data = tmp,
          exact = FALSE
        )
      )
      
      group_medians <- tmp[
        ,
        .(median_factor = median(factor_value, na.rm = TRUE)),
        by = clinical_value
      ]
      
      estimate <- diff(group_medians$median_factor)
      
      return(data.table(
        factor = factor_col,
        clinical_feature = clinical_col,
        variable_type = variable_type,
        test_used = "Wilcoxon rank-sum",
        n_samples = nrow(tmp),
        n_groups = n_groups,
        estimate = estimate,
        p_value = wt$p.value
      ))
      
    } else {
      
      kt <- suppressWarnings(
        kruskal.test(
          factor_value ~ clinical_value,
          data = tmp
        )
      )
      
      return(data.table(
        factor = factor_col,
        clinical_feature = clinical_col,
        variable_type = variable_type,
        test_used = "Kruskal-Wallis",
        n_samples = nrow(tmp),
        n_groups = n_groups,
        estimate = NA_real_,
        p_value = kt$p.value
      ))
    }
  }
}
```

```{r run-factor-clinical-association-tests}
# Run all factor-clinical association tests

association_list <- list()

for (ff in factor_cols) {
  
  for (cc in clinical_continuous) {
    association_list[[length(association_list) + 1]] <- test_factor_clinical(
      dt = factor_meta_dt,
      factor_col = ff,
      clinical_col = cc,
      variable_type = "continuous"
    )
  }
  
  for (cc in clinical_categorical) {
    association_list[[length(association_list) + 1]] <- test_factor_clinical(
      dt = factor_meta_dt,
      factor_col = ff,
      clinical_col = cc,
      variable_type = "categorical"
    )
  }
}

factor_clinical_assoc_dt <- rbindlist(association_list, fill = TRUE)

factor_clinical_assoc_dt[
  ,
  FDR := p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
]

factor_clinical_assoc_dt[
  ,
  neg_log10_p := -log10(p_value)
]

factor_clinical_assoc_dt[
  ,
  p_label := fifelse(
    is.na(p_value),
    "NA",
    fifelse(
      p_value < 0.001,
      "<0.001",
      sprintf("%.3f", p_value)
    )
  )
]

factor_clinical_assoc_dt[
  ,
  FDR_label := fifelse(
    is.na(FDR),
    "NA",
    fifelse(
      FDR < 0.001,
      "<0.001",
      sprintf("%.3f", FDR)
    )
  )
]

factor_clinical_assoc_dt <- factor_clinical_assoc_dt[
  order(factor, clinical_feature)
]

factor_clinical_assoc_dt

fwrite(
  factor_clinical_assoc_dt,
  file.path(DOWNSTREAM_DIR, "MOFA2_factor_clinical_association_tests.tsv"),

)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Ranked GSEA using all RNA genes and signed MOFA2 weights.
# Factor 1 and Factor 2 are analyzed separately.
# ============================================================

# -----------------------------
# R library
# -----------------------------
USER_LIB <- "/ihome/alee/rak373/R/x86_64-pc-linux-gnu-library/4.6"
.libPaths(c(USER_LIB, .libPaths()))

required_packages <- c(
  "data.table",
  "ggplot2",
  "fgsea",
  "msigdbr",
  "AnnotationDbi",
  "org.Hs.eg.db"
)

missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(
    required_packages,
    requireNamespace,
    logical(1),
    quietly = TRUE
  )
]

if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing packages: ",
    paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "),
    "\nInstall them first, then rerun."
  )
}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(fgsea)
  library(msigdbr)
  library(AnnotationDbi)
  library(org.Hs.eg.db)
})

set.seed(42)

# -----------------------------
# Paths and settings
# -----------------------------
OUT_DIR <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/MOFA2/Updated"

DOWNSTREAM_DIR <- file.path(
  OUT_DIR,
  "MOFA2_Downstream"
)

GSEA_DIR <- file.path(
  OUT_DIR,
  "MOFA2_Pathway_GSEA_Factor1_Factor2"
)

dir.create(
  GSEA_DIR,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

WEIGHTS_FILE <- file.path(
  DOWNSTREAM_DIR,
  "MOFA2_feature_weights_long.tsv"
)

RNA_VIEW <- "RNA_VST_top5000var"
FACTORS_TO_TEST <- c("Factor1", "Factor2")

MIN_PATHWAY_SIZE <- 10
MAX_PATHWAY_SIZE <- 500
FDR_CUTOFF <- 0.05
TOP_PATHWAYS_PER_DIRECTION <- 8

if (!file.exists(WEIGHTS_FILE)) {
  stop("Cannot find file: ", WEIGHTS_FILE)
}

# -----------------------------
# Read all RNA MOFA weights
# -----------------------------
weights_dt <- fread(WEIGHTS_FILE)

required_columns <- c(
  "view",
  "factor",
  "feature",
  "value"
)

missing_columns <- setdiff(
  required_columns,
  colnames(weights_dt)
)

if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required columns: ",
    paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

rna_weights <- weights_dt[
  view == RNA_VIEW &
    factor %in% FACTORS_TO_TEST,
  .(
    factor = as.character(factor),
    feature = as.character(feature),
    weight = as.numeric(value)
  )
]

rna_weights <- rna_weights[
  is.finite(weight)
]

if (nrow(rna_weights) == 0) {
  stop("No RNA weights found for Factor1 or Factor2.")
}

# -----------------------------
# Map Ensembl IDs to gene symbols
# -----------------------------
rna_weights[
  ,
  feature_clean := sub("\\..*$", "", feature)
]

# Remove accidental view suffix if it exists.
rna_weights[
  ,
  gene_symbol := sub(
    "_RNA_VST_top5000var$",
    "",
    feature_clean
  )
]

ensembl_ids <- unique(
  rna_weights[
    grepl("^ENSG[0-9]+$", feature_clean),
    feature_clean
  ]
)

if (length(ensembl_ids) > 0) {

  ensembl_map <- AnnotationDbi::select(
    org.Hs.eg.db,
    keys = ensembl_ids,
    keytype = "ENSEMBL",
    columns = "SYMBOL"
  )

  ensembl_map <- as.data.table(ensembl_map)

  ensembl_map <- ensembl_map[
    !is.na(SYMBOL) &
      SYMBOL != ""
  ][
    ,
    .SD[1],
    by = ENSEMBL
  ]

  setnames(
    ensembl_map,
    old = c("ENSEMBL", "SYMBOL"),
    new = c("feature_clean", "mapped_symbol")
  )

  rna_weights <- merge(
    rna_weights,
    ensembl_map,
    by = "feature_clean",
    all.x = TRUE
  )

  rna_weights[
    !is.na(mapped_symbol) &
      mapped_symbol != "",
    gene_symbol := mapped_symbol
  ]
}

rna_weights <- rna_weights[
  !is.na(gene_symbol) &
    gene_symbol != "" &
    is.finite(weight)
]

# Retain one entry per gene and factor:
# the entry with the largest absolute MOFA weight.
rna_weights_unique <- rna_weights[
  ,
  .SD[which.max(abs(weight))],
  by = .(factor, gene_symbol)
]

rna_weights_unique <- rna_weights_unique[
  order(factor, -weight)
]

fwrite(
  rna_weights_unique,
  file.path(
    GSEA_DIR,
    "Factor1_Factor2_all_RNA_weights_mapped.tsv"
  ),
  sep = "\t"
)

# -----------------------------
# Helper: retrieve MSigDB data
# Works with recent and older msigdbr versions.
# -----------------------------
get_msigdb <- function(collection_name, subcollection_name = NULL) {

  msigdbr_arguments <- names(
    formals(msigdbr::msigdbr)
  )

  if ("collection" %in% msigdbr_arguments) {

    arguments <- list(
      species = "Homo sapiens",
      collection = collection_name
    )

    if (
      !is.null(subcollection_name) &&
      "subcollection" %in% msigdbr_arguments
    ) {
      arguments$subcollection <- subcollection_name
    }

  } else {

    arguments <- list(
      species = "Homo sapiens",
      category = collection_name
    )

    if (
      !is.null(subcollection_name) &&
      "subcategory" %in% msigdbr_arguments
    ) {
      arguments$subcategory <- subcollection_name
    }
  }

  as.data.table(
    do.call(
      msigdbr::msigdbr,
      arguments
    )
  )
}

# -----------------------------
# Get pathway collections
# -----------------------------
msig_hallmark <- get_msigdb(
  collection_name = "H"
)

msig_reactome <- get_msigdb(
  collection_name = "C2",
  subcollection_name = "CP:REACTOME"
)

msig_go_bp <- get_msigdb(
  collection_name = "C5",
  subcollection_name = "GO:BP"
)

make_pathway_list <- function(msig_dt) {

  msig_dt <- msig_dt[
    !is.na(gene_symbol) &
      gene_symbol != "" &
      !is.na(gs_name) &
      gs_name != ""
  ]

  split(
    x = msig_dt$gene_symbol,
    f = msig_dt$gs_name
  )
}

pathway_collections <- list(
  Hallmark = make_pathway_list(msig_hallmark),
  Reactome = make_pathway_list(msig_reactome),
  GO_BP = make_pathway_list(msig_go_bp)
)

# -----------------------------
# Helper: run one GSEA analysis
# -----------------------------
run_gsea <- function(
  factor_weight_dt,
  pathways,
  factor_name,
  collection_name
) {

  ranks <- setNames(
    factor_weight_dt$weight,
    factor_weight_dt$gene_symbol
  )

  ranks <- sort(
    ranks,
    decreasing = TRUE
  )

  if (length(ranks) < 100) {
    stop(
      "Too few genes for GSEA in ",
      factor_name
    )
  }

  result_dt <- fgseaMultilevel(
    pathways = pathways,
    stats = ranks,
    minSize = MIN_PATHWAY_SIZE,
    maxSize = MAX_PATHWAY_SIZE
  )

  result_dt <- as.data.table(result_dt)

  # Convert list column to text for TSV export.
  if ("leadingEdge" %in% colnames(result_dt)) {
    result_dt[
      ,
      leadingEdge := vapply(
        leadingEdge,
        function(x) paste(x, collapse = ";"),
        character(1)
      )
    ]
  }

  result_dt[
    ,
    `:=`(
      factor = factor_name,
      collection = collection_name,
      direction = fifelse(
        NES > 0,
        "Positive Factor weights",
        "Negative Factor weights"
      )
    )
  ]

  result_dt[]
}

# -----------------------------
# Run GSEA separately:
# Factor 1 and Factor 2
# -----------------------------
gsea_list <- list()

for (ff in FACTORS_TO_TEST) {

  factor_weight_dt <- rna_weights_unique[
    factor == ff
  ]

  for (collection_name in names(pathway_collections)) {

    message(
      "Running GSEA: ",
      ff,
      " | ",
      collection_name
    )

    result_name <- paste(
      ff,
      collection_name,
      sep = "_"
    )

    gsea_list[[result_name]] <- run_gsea(
      factor_weight_dt = factor_weight_dt,
      pathways = pathway_collections[[collection_name]],
      factor_name = ff,
      collection_name = collection_name
    )
  }
}

gsea_results <- rbindlist(
  gsea_list,
  use.names = TRUE,
  fill = TRUE
)

# Use order(), not setorder(), because abs(NES) is an expression.
gsea_results <- gsea_results[
  order(
    factor,
    collection,
    padj,
    -abs(NES)
  )
]

fwrite(
  gsea_results,
  file.path(
    GSEA_DIR,
    "Factor1_Factor2_ranked_GSEA_all_results.tsv"
  ),
  sep = "\t"
)

# -----------------------------
# FDR-significant results
# -----------------------------
gsea_significant <- gsea_results[
  !is.na(padj) &
    padj < FDR_CUTOFF
]

fwrite(
  gsea_significant,
  file.path(
    GSEA_DIR,
    "Factor1_Factor2_ranked_GSEA_FDR_significant.tsv"
  ),
  sep = "\t"
)

# -----------------------------
# Presentation pathway table
# Hallmark pathways only
# -----------------------------
ppt_dt <- gsea_significant[
  collection == "Hallmark"
]

if (nrow(ppt_dt) > 0) {

  ppt_dt <- ppt_dt[
    ,
    .SD[
      order(-abs(NES), padj)
    ][
      seq_len(
        min(.N, TOP_PATHWAYS_PER_DIRECTION)
      )
    ],
    by = .(factor, direction)
  ]

  ppt_dt[
    ,
    pathway_label := gsub(
      "_",
      " ",
      sub("^HALLMARK_", "", pathway)
    )
  ]

  fwrite(
    ppt_dt,
    file.path(
      GSEA_DIR,
      "PPT_Factor1_Factor2_Hallmark_top_pathways.tsv"
    ),
    sep = "\t"
  )

  # Unique IDs allow separate ordering in every facet.
  ppt_dt[
    ,
    panel := paste(
      factor,
      direction,
      sep = " | "
    )
  ]

  ppt_dt[
    ,
    pathway_id := paste(
      panel,
      pathway_label,
      sep = "___"
    )
  ]

  ordered_pathways <- ppt_dt[
    order(NES),
    pathway_id
  ]

  ppt_dt[
    ,
    pathway_id := factor(
      pathway_id,
      levels = unique(ordered_pathways)
    )
  ]

  p_gsea <- ggplot(
    ppt_dt,
    aes(
      x = NES,
      y = pathway_id,
      fill = NES
    )
  ) +
    geom_col(width = 0.75) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0,
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.4
    ) +
    facet_wrap(
      ~ panel,
      scales = "free_y",
      ncol = 2
    ) +
    scale_y_discrete(
      labels = function(x) {
        sub("^.*___", "", x)
      }
    ) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "#3C78A8",
      mid = "white",
      high = "#B4513C",
      midpoint = 0,
      name = "NES"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "Ranked pathway analysis of Factors 1 and 2",
      subtitle = "Hallmark pathways; BH-FDR < 0.05",
      x = "Normalized enrichment score",
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 18
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        size = 13
      ),
      axis.text.y = element_text(
        size = 9
      ),
      strip.text = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 12
      ),
      legend.position = "right"
    )

  print(p_gsea)

  ggsave(
    file.path(
      GSEA_DIR,
      "PPT_Factor1_Factor2_Hallmark_ranked_GSEA.pdf"
    ),
    p_gsea,
    width = 13,
    height = 9
  )

  ggsave(
    file.path(
      GSEA_DIR,
      "PPT_Factor1_Factor2_Hallmark_ranked_GSEA.png"
    ),
    p_gsea,
    width = 13,
    height = 9,
    dpi = 300
  )

} else {

  message(
    "No Hallmark pathways passed BH-FDR < ",
    FDR_CUTOFF,
    ". Review the full results table for nominal findings."
  )
}

# -----------------------------
# Save run summary
# -----------------------------
genes_per_factor <- rna_weights_unique[
  ,
  .N,
  by = factor
]

summary_dt <- data.table(
  Metric = c(
    "RNA view",
    "Factors analyzed separately",
    "Mapped genes per factor",
    "Pathway collections",
    "FDR cutoff",
    "Total GSEA pathways tested",
    "FDR-significant pathways"
  ),
  Value = c(
    RNA_VIEW,
    paste(FACTORS_TO_TEST, collapse = "; "),
    paste(
      genes_per_factor[
        ,
        paste(factor, N, sep = "=")
      ],
      collapse = "; "
    ),
    paste(
      names(pathway_collections),
      collapse = "; "
    ),
    FDR_CUTOFF,
    nrow(gsea_results),
    nrow(gsea_significant)
  )
)

fwrite(
  summary_dt,
  file.path(
    GSEA_DIR,
    "Factor1_Factor2_ranked_GSEA_summary.tsv"
  ),
  sep = "\t"
)

message("Completed ranked GSEA.")
message("Results saved in: ", GSEA_DIR)
```

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)

GSEA_DIR <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/MOFA2/Updated/MOFA2_Pathway_GSEA_Factor1_Factor2"

make_gsea_plot <- function(df, factor_name) {

  plot_dt <- copy(df[factor == factor_name])

  if (nrow(plot_dt) == 0) {
    stop(paste("No significant pathways found for", factor_name))
  }

  # Order pathways by NES within this factor
  setorder(plot_dt, NES)
  plot_dt[, pathway_label := make.unique(pathway_label)]

    levels = pathway_label
  )]

      xintercept = 0,
      color = "grey35",
      linewidth = 0.4

    geom_col(width = 0.72) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = collection_colors,
      name = "Pathway collection"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.05))
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(
        factor_name,
        ": significant pathways from RNA-weight GSEA"
      ),
      subtitle = "All displayed pathways have FDR < 0.05",
      x = "Normalized enrichment score (NES)",
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold")
    )
}

# Height adapts to the number of pathways
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Factor 1 RNA weights and candidate immune-TIL axis
# ============================================================

library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)

# -----------------------------
# Paths
# -----------------------------
DOWNSTREAM_DIR <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/MOFA2/Updated/MOFA2_Downstream"

weights_file <- file.path(
  DOWNSTREAM_DIR,
  "MOFA2_top25_positive_negative_weights_by_view_factor.tsv"
)

if (!file.exists(weights_file)) {
  stop("Cannot find weight table: ", weights_file)
}

# -----------------------------
# Load and filter Factor 1 RNA weights
# -----------------------------
weights_dt <- fread(weights_file)

required_cols <- c(
  "view", "factor", "feature",
  "value", "abs_weight", "direction"
)

missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, colnames(weights_dt))

if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing columns in input table: ",
    paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

factor1_rna_dt <- weights_dt[
  view == "RNA_VST_top5000var" &
    factor == "Factor1"
]

if (nrow(factor1_rna_dt) == 0) {
  stop("No Factor 1 RNA weights found.")
}

# -----------------------------
# Define candidate immune-associated transcripts
# -----------------------------
immune_features <- c(
  "KLRK1-AS1",
  "GZMH-AS1",
  "CCR5AS",
  "PSMB8-AS1"
)

# -----------------------------
# Select displayed features
# -----------------------------

# Top 7 negative weights by absolute magnitude
negative_top <- factor1_rna_dt[
  direction == "Negative"
][
  order(abs_weight, decreasing = TRUE)
][
  seq_len(min(.N, 7))
]

# Force-add the immune-associated negative features,
# even if they are not among the top 7 by absolute weight.
negative_immune <- factor1_rna_dt[
  direction == "Negative" &
    feature %in% immune_features
]

negative_dt <- unique(
  rbindlist(
    list(negative_top, negative_immune),
    use.names = TRUE,
    fill = TRUE
  ),
  by = "feature"
)

# Top 8 positive weights by absolute magnitude
positive_dt <- factor1_rna_dt[
  direction == "Positive"
][
  order(abs_weight, decreasing = TRUE)
][
  seq_len(min(.N, 8))
]

plot_dt <- rbindlist(
  list(negative_dt, positive_dt),
  use.names = TRUE,
  fill = TRUE
)

# Add an asterisk to the selected immune-associated transcripts
plot_dt[
  ,
  feature_label := fifelse(
    feature %in% immune_features,
    paste0(feature, " *"),
    feature
  )
]

# Order labels from most negative to most positive
plot_dt[
  ,
  feature_label := factor(
    feature_label,
    levels = feature_label[order(value)]
  )
]

# -----------------------------
# Create plot
# -----------------------------
p_factor1_immune <- ggplot(
  plot_dt,
  aes(
    x = feature_label,
    y = value,
    fill = direction
  )
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Negative" = "#3C78A8",
      "Positive" = "#B4513C"
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-1.15, 1.25),
    breaks = c(-1, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Factor 1 RNA weights: candidate immune-TIL axis",
    subtitle = "Negative Factor 1 scores are associated with higher TIL levels",
    x = NULL,
    y = "MOFA2 RNA feature weight",
    fill = NULL,
    caption = paste(
      "* Candidate immune-associated antisense transcripts:",
      "KLRK1-AS1, GZMH-AS1, CCR5AS, and PSMB8-AS1."
    )
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 21
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 15,
      margin = margin(b = 12)
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 13
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 12
    ),
    axis.title.x = element_text(
      size = 15
    ),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 14
    ),
    plot.caption = element_text(
      hjust = 0,
      face = "italic",
      size = 11,
      margin = margin(t = 12)
    ),
    plot.margin = margin(
      t = 15,
      r = 25,
      b = 20,
      l = 15
    )
  )

print(p_factor1_immune)

# -----------------------------
# Save PPT-ready outputs
# -----------------------------
pdf_file <- file.path(
  DOWNSTREAM_DIR,
  "Factor1_RNA_candidate_immune_TIL_axis.pdf"
)

png_file <- file.path(
  DOWNSTREAM_DIR,
  "Factor1_RNA_candidate_immune_TIL_axis.png"
)

ggsave(
  filename = pdf_file,
  plot = p_factor1_immune,
  width = 12,
  height = 8,
  units = "in"
)

ggsave(
  filename = png_file,
  plot = p_factor1_immune,
  width = 12,
  height = 8,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300
)

message("Saved PDF: ", pdf_file)
message("Saved PNG: ", png_file)
```
